lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Mg12Hg2 (YMg6Hg) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Hg, Mg, and Y centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.25 to 3.45 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Hg- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
